title: Suggested poses for owner review

proposals.label: Pointing left
proposals.reason: Lets a character direct your attention to a diagram or control on the left while keeping the explanation visually grounded.
proposals.visual: One clear extended arm; other hand relaxed.

proposals.label: Pointing right
proposals.reason: Provides the opposite pointing direction so the character can indicate content without awkwardly mirroring every feature of their design.
proposals.visual: A separately authored opposite gesture, keeping anatomical identity.

proposals.label: Open-palm presentation
proposals.reason: Introduces an option or idea with an inviting gesture, useful when the character is offering a choice rather than telling you what to do.
proposals.visual: One open palm, upright relaxed posture.

proposals.label: Small wave
proposals.reason: Gives arrivals and goodbyes a compact, friendly signal that can work in a corner without taking over the screen.
proposals.visual: Compact raised hand with readable fingers.

proposals.label: Polite bow
proposals.reason: Adds a restrained acknowledgment or thank-you, giving the character a quieter response than a wave or celebration.
proposals.visual: Slight torso tilt, hands kept clear.
proposals.useCase: Acknowledge a request or thank someone

proposals.label: Leaning in to listen
proposals.reason: Shows active attention during your explanation, making listening feel different from waiting for a task to finish.
proposals.visual: Forward tilt and open shoulders, no work prop.

proposals.label: Curious inspection
proposals.reason: Makes curiosity visible when something unfamiliar catches the character's attention, supporting interests beyond their assigned specialty.
proposals.visual: Head tilted toward a small floating detail.

proposals.label: Chin resting on hand
proposals.reason: Offers a relaxed, thoughtful resting state for longer conversations without implying that the character is busy typing or searching.
proposals.visual: Seated elbow support with face and hand separated.

proposals.label: Eureka
proposals.reason: Marks the moment an explanation or solution clicks, useful for revealing a connection rather than celebrating the entire task.
proposals.visual: Raised finger, lifted head, sudden confident posture.

proposals.label: Skeptical
proposals.reason: Gives respectful doubt a recognizable expression, so disagreement can feel like considered judgment rather than an error state.
proposals.visual: One raised brow/tilted head; asymmetrical arm gesture.

proposals.label: Surprised
proposals.reason: Separates a genuine unexpected result from confusion, adding a clear reaction when the character encounters something surprising.
proposals.visual: Hands slightly spread and shoulders lifted.

proposals.label: Reassuring
proposals.reason: Supports encouragement after a setback with an open, nonjudgmental gesture instead of making every supportive response look worried.
proposals.visual: Open hand offered forward, soft lean.

proposals.label: Apologetic / correcting
proposals.reason: Helps acknowledge and correct a real mistake, with a modest gesture that avoids making the apology more dramatic than the problem.
proposals.visual: Small downward head tilt and corrective hand gesture.

proposals.label: Relieved
proposals.reason: Provides a quiet release of tension after something works, giving success a less energetic alternative to cheering.
proposals.visual: Lowered shoulders, hand against chest or side.

proposals.label: Disappointed
proposals.reason: Acknowledges a disappointing result without implying that the character has given up, preserving a useful distinction from frustration.
proposals.visual: Slumped but attentive posture, no exaggerated despair.

proposals.label: Embarrassed
proposals.reason: Adds a human-readable awkward or bashful reaction for playful conversation, broadening emotional range beyond task status.
proposals.visual: Turned head and one hand near cheek.

proposals.label: Determined
proposals.reason: Signals readiness to tackle a difficult problem, giving commitment a clear silhouette without making the character look angry.
proposals.visual: Firm stance and forward-facing shoulders.

proposals.label: Smug / teasing
proposals.reason: Gives teasing observations a confident visual tone, useful for short playful moments when that personality fits the conversation.
proposals.visual: Hip shift, tilted head, one small presenting gesture.

proposals.label: Arms folded, amused
proposals.reason: Provides a relaxed, amused reaction to a joke or familiar situation, showing warmth without turning every laugh into a large gesture.
proposals.visual: Relaxed crossed arms; tilted head.

proposals.label: Deadpan
proposals.reason: Supports dry humor with minimal movement, especially when a deliberately understated reaction would land better than an animated one.
proposals.visual: Still upright silhouette and one minimal hand gesture.

proposals.label: Facepalm
proposals.reason: Adds an unmistakable comic reaction to an obvious silly mistake; it should remain contextual rather than a default response to the user.
proposals.visual: One hand to brow; face shape remains legible.

proposals.label: Double take
proposals.reason: Shows that the character has noticed something worth reconsidering, useful for a humorous second look or a sudden change of interpretation.
proposals.visual: Over-shoulder head turn with paused body.

proposals.label: Stretching
proposals.reason: Gives break reminders and transitions out of focused work a distinct full-body silhouette, adding variety to idle behavior.
proposals.visual: Arms overhead, long angular silhouette.

proposals.label: Sleepy nod
proposals.reason: Provides a gentle winding-down pose for late-night conversation or a goodnight scene, distinct from being upset or disengaged.
proposals.visual: Seated with lowered head, supported by one hand.
proposals.useCase: Wind down after a long session

proposals.label: Storytelling / DM narration
proposals.reason: Supports prose and D&D narration with a broad storytelling gesture, letting the Academic act as an imaginative collaborator as well as a teacher.
proposals.visual: Book aside; broad narrative gesture.
proposals.useCase: Narrate prose or a D&D scene

proposals.label: Building a diagram
proposals.reason: Shows an explanation being constructed step by step, matching the goal of teaching through visible diagrams rather than only presenting finished answers.
proposals.visual: One hand places a shape, the other links it.

proposals.label: Annotating a passage
proposals.reason: Distinguishes close reading and critique from drafting new prose, useful when discussing a quotation, revising wording, or examining an argument.
proposals.visual: Book or page flat, writing hand distinct.

proposals.label: Experiment / discovery
proposals.reason: Makes the Academic's curious streak visible during exploration, giving discovery a different feel from confidently explaining known material.
proposals.visual: Simple experiment prop and attentive lean.

proposals.label: Comparing sources
proposals.reason: Communicates comparison between sources or interpretations, useful when evidence conflicts and the answer requires weighing alternatives.
proposals.visual: Two books/pages held at different heights.

proposals.label: Rolling dice
proposals.reason: Adds a recognizable tabletop action for D&D sessions, making a roll or playful uncertainty feel different from ordinary academic work.
proposals.visual: Hand just released, a few geometric dice.

proposals.label: Behind a DM screen
proposals.reason: Provides a clear game-master identity for running a scene, with room for expressive hands while the screen keeps the silhouette simple.
proposals.visual: Head and hands visible above a simple screen.

proposals.label: Building a world map
proposals.reason: Supports collaborative worldbuilding, geography, and campaign planning by showing the character actively shaping a setting.
proposals.visual: Seated over a map, pointing and drawing hands separated.

proposals.label: Reading aloud
proposals.reason: Separates delivering a passage from silently studying it, useful for narrated prose, a dramatic quotation, or an explanation built around a text.
proposals.visual: Book in one hand, conversational free hand.
proposals.useCase: Deliver prose or explain a quotation

proposals.label: Writer pausing mid-sentence
proposals.reason: Shows the pause involved in choosing words, giving writing and revision a reflective state rather than continuous fake typing.
proposals.visual: Pen suspended above a page, tilted head.

proposals.label: Reviewing a diff
proposals.reason: Makes before-and-after code comparison visible, helping distinguish reviewing a proposed change from writing or debugging code.
proposals.visual: Two small panels, a precise pointing gesture.

proposals.label: Investigating logs
proposals.reason: Signals evidence gathering across diagnostic output, useful when the Hacker is tracing a problem instead of already claiming to know the cause.
proposals.visual: Lean toward a narrow stack of log panels.

proposals.label: Waiting for a build
proposals.reason: Provides a calm waiting posture for builds or tests, so a long operation does not require constant energetic typing animations.
proposals.visual: Sideways seated, one foot moving lightly.

proposals.label: Terminal focus
proposals.reason: Offers a focused, compact working pose for local terminal tasks, giving hands-on execution a clear visual state.
proposals.visual: Compact forward lean with both hands at keyboard.

proposals.label: At a breakpoint
proposals.reason: Shows a deliberate pause to inspect program state, helping explain why debugging sometimes involves stopping and examining one detail.
proposals.visual: One hand on keyboard, other indicates a single variable.

proposals.label: Tests passed
proposals.reason: Marks a verified test result with a small victory, giving success a specific meaning rather than celebrating before checks finish.
proposals.visual: Brief fist lift or satisfied lean back.

proposals.label: Reproducing a bug locally
proposals.reason: Distinguishes reproducing a bug in a controlled local example from general investigation, reinforcing a careful evidence-first workflow.
proposals.visual: One small test window, concentrated asymmetric pose.

proposals.label: Untangling dependencies
proposals.reason: Turns an abstract dependency problem into a simple visual metaphor, supporting explanations of tangled modules or package relationships.
proposals.visual: Holds a knot of links, separates one connection.

proposals.label: Sketching a system
proposals.reason: Shows architectural thinking before implementation, giving system design a distinct pose from keyboard work or reading logs.
proposals.visual: Side-on at a board with a few boxes and arrows.

proposals.label: Keyboard flourish
proposals.reason: Adds a deliberately silly flourish after finishing, giving her confidence and humor a place beyond purely functional coding states.
proposals.visual: An angular keyboard balanced in one hand.

proposals.label: Design critique
proposals.reason: Supports the Business character's design role by showing evaluation of a layout or proposal, broadening his identity beyond spreadsheets.
proposals.visual: Standing beside a layout, one measured gesture.

proposals.label: Delegating a task
proposals.reason: Makes a handoff to another specialist visible, useful for explaining delegation and who is currently responsible for the next step.
proposals.visual: Hands a task card toward another character.

proposals.label: Delivering a report
proposals.reason: Distinguishes presenting a finished report from drafting one, creating a clear moment for the morning-results or task-completion experience.
proposals.visual: Closed report offered forward.

proposals.label: Weighing a tradeoff
proposals.reason: Shows two competing options being weighed, useful for business decisions where priorities and tradeoffs matter more than a single confident answer.
proposals.visual: Two open hands at unequal heights.

proposals.label: Prioritizing
proposals.reason: Makes reprioritization visible with one task moving ahead of others, matching the need to keep the next steps manageable.
proposals.visual: Moves one task card above a short stack.

proposals.label: Listening in a meeting
proposals.reason: Provides an attentive, restrained listening pose for planning conversations, showing that straightforwardness can still include patience.
proposals.visual: Seated, hands calmly together, slight forward lean.

proposals.label: Checking a budget
proposals.reason: Signals deliberate review of costs and constraints, distinguishing financial judgment from generic research or report writing.
proposals.visual: Spreadsheet beside a small calculator; pointing hand clear.

proposals.label: Monitoring a long task
proposals.reason: Represents checking the progress of a long-running task, useful for an eventual overnight-work interface without pretending that monitoring is the work itself.
proposals.visual: Standing at a compact progress board.

proposals.label: Reviewing a risk
proposals.reason: Makes a consequential concern visible before action, supporting clear communication about uncertainty, dependencies, or decisions needing the owner's input.
proposals.visual: One hand holds a caution card, other steadies report.

proposals.label: Closing the laptop
proposals.reason: Gives a completed session a recognizable ending, pairing a relaxed posture with the point where the character can summarize and hand control back.
proposals.visual: Hand on closing lid, relaxed shoulders.

rules: Available art is separate from proposed additions.
Personality and humor extend beyond job specialty.
